title: Performance obligation taxonomy and crediting language for dedicated throughput
creator: Anjali Rao
description: Purpose: produce a clear, auditable taxonomy for 'throughput obligations' offered on Dedicated (tokens/minute and sustained tokens/hour), define an error-budget computation compatible with our telemetry, and draft contract language (customer-facing SLA + remedy credit formulas). Scope: wording for SLO periods (rolling 1h, 24h, 30d), quantile vs mean measurements, burst vs sustained capacity, autoscale interaction, and credit caps. Out of scope: legal negotiation templates and pricing schedule redlines.
acceptance_criteria: Canonical SLA wording for dedicated throughput including metric definitions and measurement windows
Formal error budget formula that maps observed serve-rate and latency signals into credit units
Example contract clause (plain-language and legal appendix) with a capped credit schedule and escalation timeline
Measurement spec and proto dashboard enabling replication of SLA calculations from production telemetry
Playbook for incident -> credit issuance flow with roles, notification windows, and automated credit calculation script
comments: 2026-02-20 | Anjali Rao: Initial ticket created after product/infra sync. Primary ask from enterprise sales - make SLA and crediting deterministic and easy to reason about. Assigned to Martin.

2026-02-24 | Martin Keller: Completed first-pass taxonomy. Proposed distinguishing 'sustained capacity' (24h rolling avg) vs 'burst capacity' (tokens/min P99 over 1h) and tying credits to sustained shortfall. Uploaded taxonomy draft to Confluence.

2026-03-01 | Legal (S. Park): Reviewed draft contract clauses. Requested explicit cap on aggregate credits (suggested 6 months revenue cap) and a definition for 'attributable incident' to prevent double-crediting. Marked legal-review label.

2026-03-04 | Engineering (L. Nguyen): Raised measurement concern: current telemetry computes tokens/min aggregated per AZ; need per-customer, per-model windowed counts for accurate error-budget. ENG ticket created ENG-8421. Proposed interim: use sampled per-request counters and 1h rollups.

2026-03-07 | Martin Keller: Updated SLA language to use P50/P95/P99 quantiles for 'throughput serviceability' and added formula for computing 'shortfall tokens' = max(0, committed_tokens - served_tokens_over_window). See Draft PR #128.

2026-03-10 | Customer Success (R. Alvarez): Feedback from an early enterprise customer: prefer monthly credits, simple to communicate. We need both a technical credit computation and a simplified example for contracts. Added examples to Confluence.

2026-03-12 | Anjali Rao: Ready for cross-functional review (Engineering, Legal, CS). Reminder: coordinate with Autoscale team on interaction model (fallbacks, burst allowances). Next: legal to produce final clause, ENG to close telemetry gap (ENG-8421), QA to validate dashboard reproduction.
